layout_description: Six equal panels in a two-row, three-column grid. Columns represent IoU, background false-positive rate, and overall recall. The top row shows three arm means with seed SD; the bottom row shows two paired mine contrasts with 95% bootstrap intervals. Use separate row legends and percentage versus percentage-point axis labels. There are no flow arrows between rows: the rows summarize the same archived runs in different statistical ways. Reserve a narrow footer for the small-change NA note.

caption_note: MCT-P01采用50个训练矿区的1,188片和10个验证矿区的480片，三组各运行种子17、29、43；官方测试未读取。
上排为三个种子的矿区宏平均及种子样本标准差，单位为%；下排先在每矿区内平均种子，再对十个矿区进行配对重采样，表示95%区间，单位为百分点。两类误差条不可互换。
背景减全区域的IoU、FPR、总体召回差分别约为+0.760、−3.348、−4.105个百分点，对应95%区间为[−0.057,1.515]、[−4.217,−2.567]、[−6.236,−2.233]；背景减无约束的三项区间均跨零。保留全部六项比较，不宣称联合优势已获支持。
预定小变化端点在480片中没有合格对象，记NA；它不等于零召回，也不能被总体召回替代。
上排色形表示实验组，下排色形表示比较对象；分别标注图例。完整数值、协议和解释保留在外部图注。

RENDERING_RULES_AND_NEGATIVE_PROMPT_INST: NUMERICAL DATA MUST BE RENDERED PROGRAMMATICALLY FROM data_payload. Image-model output may only be a non-evidential layout study, never the scientific chart.
Render text ONLY within designated exact_* fields; all other prose is production guidance.
All container boxes use WHITE (#FFFFFF) fill with COLORED BORDERS ONLY; preserve native pixels inside real source-image assets.
Use title 10–12pt, primary label 8–9pt, secondary label 7–8pt and tensor notes 6–7pt; keep labels readable after final placement.
Use 1.5pt container borders and forward arrows, 1.0pt dividers and feedback arrows; align objects on a consistent grid.
Icons are monochrome dark-grey thin line art, one visual anchor per major block; no decorative pictograms.
Weight status uses a solid border with [训练] for trainable weights, a dashed grey border with [固定] for frozen weights; do not assign weight status to ordinary data.
Main forward flow arrows are SOLID; feedback arrows DASHED; optional-extension edges DOTTED. No held-out test feedback into development.
NO emojis, NO lock/fire/lightning icons, NO 3D rendering; no gradients, shadows, invented achievements or winner badges.
Use no more than three specified chromatic colors plus neutrals; source raster colors remain unchanged.
Long formulas, thresholds without frozen values, citations and explanatory sentences belong in caption_note, never in module boxes.
No fabricated measurements, ROC curves, confusion scores, geographic coordinates, model layers or environmental-risk categories.
This package is planning-only: do not execute image generation or plot rendering without the subsequent task to produce figures.

top_row.interval: sample standard deviation across the three seed-level mine-macro means
top_row.axis_policy: Each panel labels its own percent scale; retain complete error bars.

bottom_row.axis_policy: Include every point and the complete archived confidence interval; no clipping.

data_semantics: Top: arm means and sample SD across three seed-level mine-macro means. Bottom: background minus comparator, seeds averaged within each mine, then paired-mine bootstrap 95% intervals over ten validation mines. Percent levels and percentage-point differences are distinct axes; neither row measures small-change recall.
